newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: GUCCI POSTS 103 PCT PROFIT RISE.
newsitem.headline: GUCCI POSTS 103 PCT PROFIT RISE.

text.p: Italian luxury goods maker Gucci Group NV said on Thursday its net income for fiscal 1996 rose 103 percent to $168.4 million from $82.9 million in fiscal 1995.
Gucci said this was a record financial performance, adding that all distribution channels, product categories and geographic regions had contributed to its growth.
The company designs, makes and distributes luxury accessories including leather goods, shoes, watches, jewellery and perfume.
Its shares are listed on the Amsterdam and New York stock exchanges.
